description: This file defines the SystemTrustStore interface and related factory functions for managing platform-specific SSL trust stores within the Chromium project, including support for Chrome Root Store and platform-specific trust store initialization.

classes.name: SystemTrustStore
classes.description: Interface for encapsulating platform-specific trust store operations, including retrieving trust stores, checking for known roots, and determining usage of system trust store.

methods.name: GetTrustStore
methods.description: Returns a TrustStore object used for path building, combining system and manually added trust anchors.

methods.name: UsesSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Indicates whether the implementation uses the system's trust store.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is a known root from the system trust store.

methods.name: chrome_root_store_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Chrome Root Store if supported.
